title: Do You Have to Register Your Divorce Under UCC?
desc: Under the Uniform Civil Code of Uttarakhand Act, 2024, a divorce or annulment decree must be registered, not just the marriage, with the UCC portal.
why: With over four lakh marriages already registered under Uttarakhand's Uniform Civil Code, many couples who later divorce are asking whether the decree itself also needs separate registration.
keyPoints: Under the Uniform Civil Code of Uttarakhand Act, 2024, a decree of divorce or annulment must be registered, not only the marriage.
This applies even if the decree was passed by a court outside Uttarakhand, as long as either spouse lives in the state.
Registration is done through the official portal, ucc.uk.gov.in, by submitting the decree along with identity and marriage details.
A registrar can issue a notice calling for registration, and ignoring it can invite a penalty under the Act.

sections.h: Do you need to register a divorce under Uttarakhand's UCC?
p: Yes. Under the Uniform Civil Code of Uttarakhand Act, 2024, a decree of divorce or a decree declaring a marriage null and void must be registered with the Registrar, separately from the original marriage registration. This applies in Uttarakhand even if the marriage itself was never formally registered.

The duty to register covers decrees passed by courts within Uttarakhand, and decrees passed by courts elsewhere in India if either the husband or the wife ordinarily lives in the state. Customary or pre-UCC divorces are also meant to be brought on record once the Act applies to the couple.

sections.h: How and where do you register a divorce decree?
p: Registration is done through the official UCC Uttarakhand portal, ucc.uk.gov.in, the same system used for marriage and live-in relationship registration. The applicant uploads a copy of the court's decree, proof of identity and address, and details of the earlier marriage registration, if any.

If a registrar finds that a divorce has gone unreported, the Act allows a notice to be issued asking the parties to submit the registration memorandum. The Act also prescribes a penalty for failing to comply, so it is worth completing this promptly rather than waiting for a notice.

sections.h: Why does registering the decree matter?
p: A registered divorce record makes it easier to prove marital status later, for example when applying for a fresh marriage registration, a passport, or a succession or inheritance claim. The marriage and divorce registers are also open to inspection, which can matter in disputes over remarriage or legitimacy.

whatToDo: Keep a certified copy of the divorce or annulment decree handy before you begin the online registration.
If your marriage was registered under the UCC, have that registration number ready; it speeds up the divorce entry.
Register promptly rather than waiting for a registrar's notice, since the Act penalises non-registration.
For the current forms, fees and timelines, check ucc.uk.gov.in or the Family Court, Haldwani, directly, as these details can change.

hi.title: क्या यूसीसी के तहत तलाक का पंजीकरण कराना जरूरी है?
keyPoints: उत्तराखंड यूनिफॉर्म सिविल कोड अधिनियम, 2024 के तहत केवल विवाह ही नहीं, तलाक या विवाह-शून्यता की डिक्री का भी पंजीकरण कराना अनिवार्य है।
यह नियम तब भी लागू होता है जब डिक्री उत्तराखंड के बाहर की अदालत से मिली हो, बशर्ते पति या पत्नी में से कोई एक राज्य में रहता हो।
पंजीकरण आधिकारिक पोर्टल ucc.uk.gov.in पर डिक्री, पहचान प्रमाण और विवाह पंजीकरण विवरण जमा करके किया जाता है।
पंजीकरण न कराने पर रजिस्ट्रार नोटिस भेज सकता है, और अधिनियम के तहत जुर्माने का प्रावधान भी है।
